items.q: What is TV Comic Book Reader?
items.a: TV Comic Book Reader is an Android TV app for opening and viewing Comic Book Comic Book files on a TV using a remote-friendly interface.

items.q: How can I add Comic Book files to the app?
items.a: You can import Comic Book files using Web Import, WiFi Upload, FTP Import, or by scanning available Comic Book files from connected storage such as USB.

items.q: Does Web Import require the phone or laptop to be on the same WiFi network as the TV?
items.a: No. Web Import uses a token-based flow, so the sending device does not need to be on the same network as the TV.

items.q: When should I use WiFi Upload instead of Web Import?
items.a: Use WiFi Upload when your sending device and Android TV are on the same network. It is designed for faster local file transfer.

items.q: Does FTP Import need the same network?
items.a: Yes. FTP Import uses an anonymous FTP connection and requires the sending device to be on the same network as the TV.

items.q: Can I bookmark slides?
items.a: Yes. You can bookmark the current slide, view bookmarks for the current Comic Book, and also browse bookmarks across all Comic Book files.

items.q: Does the app remember where I stopped?
items.a: Yes. The viewer can reopen a Comic Book with the last viewed slide number and last used view settings such as zoom and night mode.

items.q: Can I search inside Comic Book files?
items.a: Yes. The viewer includes a search option to find text inside supported Comic Book files.

items.q: Can I delete imported Comic Book files?
items.a: Yes. Long-press OK on a focused Comic Book file to view file info and options such as open and delete. Settings also include an option to clear all Comic Books in the imports folder. USB files are not deleted.

items.q: Where can I manage subscription information?
items.a: The app includes a subscribe page and a manage subscription page with information about managing your subscription.
